customerId.description: Identifier of the customer who placed the order

amount.description: Order total, e.g. "19.99". The branch 04 retype attempt was abandoned - back to the original working type.

amountNumeric.description: Order total as a number, e.g. 19.99. Optional - added alongside 'amount' without removing or retyping it, for consumers that want to do math on it.

status.description: Current order status, e.g. NEW or PAID
